abstract: The ovary can harbor neoplasms other than epithelial ovarian cancer; these include less-common primary cancers of the ovary and cancers that metastasize to the ovary from other parts of the body. Depending on the specific histology, site of origin of a metastatic lesion, extent to which the cancer has spread, and comorbid medical conditions, women with these less-common neoplasms may be candidates for aggressive surgical intervention, systemic chemotherapy, or therapy focused on symptom management and comfort.
abstract_ja: 卵巣には上皮性卵巣癌以外の腫瘍も発生しうる。これには、より稀な原発性卵巣癌や、他部位から卵巣へ転移する癌が含まれる。組織型、転移病変の原発部位、進展の程度、および併存疾患に応じて、これらの稀な腫瘍を有する女性は、積極的な外科的介入、全身化学療法、あるいは症状管理と快適性を重視した治療の対象となりうる。
